video_title: Nikola Jokic revela cómo piensa el genio que cambió la NBA | Entrevista EXCLUSIVA

quotes.speaker: Nikola Jokic
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jokic on his independent approach to reading the game
quotes.excerpt: I think I just think a lot by myself. I don't need any help from any other player.
quotes.quote: I don't think any player makes me think. I just think I think a lot by myself. I don't need any help from any other player. I simply think a lot by myself. There is no competition in that sense.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: ¿El que mas me hace pensar? No creo que ningun jugador me haga pensar mas. Yo pienso mucho por mi cuenta. No necesito la ayuda de ningun otro jugador para hacerlo. Simplemente pienso mucho por mi mismo. No hay competencia en ese sentido.

quotes.speaker: Nikola Jokic
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jokic on the complexity of adjusting to different defensive schemes
quotes.excerpt: It's not a simple answer. If it was simple, I think everybody would do it.
quotes.quote: It depends on many things. It depends on who is guarding me, if it's a smaller or bigger guy, if they are doubling me or not, and also if I'm having a good shooting day. There are many factors. It's not a simple answer. If it was simple, I think everybody would do it.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Depende de muchas cosas. Depende de quien me este defendiendo, si es un jugador mas pequeno o mas grande, si me hacen una doble marca o no, y tambien de si estoy teniendo un buen dia con mis tiros. Son muchos factores. No es una respuesta sencilla. Si fuera tan facil, creo que todo el mundo podria hacerlo.

quotes.speaker: Nikola Jokic
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jokic on the role of experience in adapting to defensive systems
quotes.excerpt: I think it's just the experience that I have through the years, I think.
quotes.quote: I think it's just the experience. I have been playing for 11 years now, so I have seen many different situations, different types of players who guard me, different teams that I played, and different teammates that I had. So it's just the experience that I have through the years, I think.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Creo que todo se basa en la experiencia. Llevo jugando entre 10 y 11 anos, asi que he visto muchas situaciones diferentes, distintos tipos de jugadores que me defienden, equipos a los que me he enfrentado y companeros con los que he jugado. Creo que todo se debe a la experiencia que he adquirido a lo largo de los anos.

quotes.speaker: Nikola Jokic
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jokic on the rapid evolution of the NBA game
quotes.excerpt: I think the basketball changed so much. In the last 10 years, it changed like four times.
quotes.quote: I think the basketball changed so much. In the last 10 years, I would say it changed like four times. The size of the players, the different tactics, and the different styles of the game. It is not just about what changed since I won my first MVP four or five years ago. I think in the last 10 years the game has evolved so much. Different players have invented new moves and new plays. The basketball as a game is developing so fast. I think next year or two years it could be completely different.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Creo que el basquetbol ha cambiado muchisimo. En los ultimos 10 anos, diria que ha cambiado unas cuatro veces. Ha cambiado el tamano de los jugadores, las tacticas y los diferentes estilos de juego. No se trata solamente de lo que ha cambiado desde que gane mi primer MVP, hace cuatro o cinco anos. Creo que en los ultimos 10 anos el juego ha evolucionado muchisimo. Diferentes jugadores han inventado nuevos movimientos y nuevas jugadas. El basquetbol esta evolucionando muy rapido. Creo que dentro de uno o dos anos podria ser completamente diferente.

quotes.speaker: Nikola Jokic
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jokic on his commitment to continuous physical and skill improvement
quotes.excerpt: If I come back a little bit better than last year, I am going to be happy.
quotes.quote: There is always space for improvement. It could be your body, your physical condition, or your shots. I cannot pick only one thing, but I think if I come back a little bit better than last year, I am going to be happy and satisfied. That would mean that I really improved compared to the previous year.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Siempre hay espacio para mejorar. Puede ser tu fisico, tu condicion fisica o tus tiros. No podria elegir solamente una cosa, pero creo que si regreso siendo un poco mejor que el ano pasado, estare feliz y satisfecho. Eso significaria que realmente mejore con respecto al ano anterior.

quotes.speaker: Nikola Jokic
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jokic on the importance of understanding the simplicity of basketball
quotes.excerpt: To understand the simplicity of the game, I think I play.
quotes.quote: I think just understanding the game, understand your teammates, understand the game, understand who you guard, just to understand the simplicity of the game, I think I play.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Creo que entender el juego, entender a tus companeros, comprender lo que sucede en la cancha y conocer al jugador que estas defendiendo. Simplemente entender la sencillez del basquetbol, creo que yo juego.
